sentences: `image_bvh_intersect_ray` / `image_bvh64_intersect_ray` (64 CS: RT shadows) are one traversal step against AMD's hardware BVH node format.
The traversal loop lives in the game's shader.
The step is emulated over buffer reads following Mesa RADV's software path (`radv_nir_rt_common.c`, `intersect_ray_amd_software_box/_tri`; node layouts from `bvh_defines.h`).
Node id = address >> 3 \| type (0–3 triangle, 4 box16, 5 box32).
Box nodes give the four child ids, with misses and NaN boxes = `0xFFFFFFFF`, sorted by entry distance when descriptor bit 63 (box_sort_enable) is set.
Triangle nodes read their three vertices from the slots the node type picks: TRI0 (0,1,2), TRI1 (1,3,2), TRI2 (2,3,4), TRI3 (2,4,0), 12 bytes each.
They use the watertight test with RADV's shared edge/vertex tie-breaks and give (t/\|det\|, sign(det), b_i/\|det\|, b_j/\|det\|), or (inf, 1, 0, 0) on a miss.
The weights i and j are chosen by the node type's byte of the triangle-ID word at +60: bits [1:0] and [3:2], 0/1/2 = vertex 0/1/2; `0x09` gives RADV's (v, w).
Vertex slots and remap follow AMD GPURT (`CalcTriangleCompressionVertexIndices`, `SwizzleBarycentrics`) and the public XDXR software path ([bvh.md](bvh.md) §7a).
These two references agree; no game BVH is decoded yet to count over.
A GPU can't confirm the rule either, because every GPU runs this emulation and none runs the native instruction.
`tests/semantic/test_image_bvh_tri.py` runs every node type and remap byte on the interpreter.
The game's code divides by `.y` exactly as for the hardware's numerator/denominator.
Address = descriptor base + ((node & ~7) << 3), base = descriptor bits [39:0] in 256-byte units (**assumption**: RADV only uses base 0).
**The runtime must build the game's acceleration structures in this AMD node format** (RADV's GPU BVH builder produces it) wherever the game's D3D12 calls build them.
Far branches with `s_sub_u32`/`s_subb_u32` (backward) are folded too.
GPU-checked with `runtime/test/shaders/cs_bvh.asm`: sorted box children and the triangle result are exact.
The 32-bit form (11 address dwords: the node id has no high dword) runs the same scene in `cs_bvh32.asm` and gives the same eight words.
